title: Generic boss
text: Each preset against a level 63 boss with no creature type. In client 70425 no racial depends on the weapon. A race plays its own rotation or gear where that beats the preset's by 2 standard errors, in every scenario; its row says what changed.

title: Beast target
text: A Beast boss turns on Troll Beast Slaying and Dwarf Big Game Hunter (5% more damage).

title: Elemental target
text: An Elemental boss turns on High Order and Windshaper Elemental Insight (5% more damage).

title: Humanoid target
text: Priests only. Dwarf Priests cast Chastise, which works only on Humanoids. No other racial cares about Humanoids.

title: Racials off
text: Every race on its base stats, with all racials left out.

title: The Human Spirit
text: Spirit increased by 10%.
short: Spirit increased by 10%.

title: Ruthless
text: +1% critical strike chance with all spells and attacks, with any weapon.
short: +1% critical strike chance with all spells and attacks, with any weapon.

title: Artisan's Precision
text: +1% hit chance with spells and attacks.
short: +1% hit chance with spells and attacks.

title: Command
text: Damage dealt by Hunter and Warlock pets increased by 5%.
short: Damage dealt by Hunter and Warlock pets increased by 5%.

title: Elune's Light
text: +10% critical strike chance for 15s, 3 min cooldown.
short: +10% critical strike chance for 15s, 3 min cooldown.

title: Shadowmeld
text: Slip into the shadows, 2 min cooldown in combat. The next stealth ability (Ravage, Ambush, Garrote) can follow it.
short: Slip into the shadows, 2 min cooldown in combat. The next stealth ability (Ravage, Ambush, Garrote) can follow it.

title: Read Leyline
text: A 2s cast that raises health and mana regeneration by 50% for 15s away from a Ley Line, 2 min cooldown.
short: A 2s cast that raises health and mana regeneration by 50% for 15s away from a Ley Line, 2 min cooldown.

title: Expansive Mind
text: Maximum Mana, Rage or Energy increased by 5%.
short: Maximum Mana, Rage or Energy increased by 5%.

title: Eureka!
text: For 8s, direct damage abilities cost 10% less and deal 10% more damage (DoTs too for Warlocks, heals too for Priests), 2 min cooldown.
short: For 8s, direct damage abilities cost 10% less and deal 10% more damage (DoTs too for Warlocks, heals too for Priests), 2 min cooldown.

title: Blood Fury
text: Attack power and spell power increased by 10% for 15s, 2 min cooldown.
short: Attack power and spell power increased by 10% for 15s, 2 min cooldown.

title: Touch of the Grave
text: Spells and attacks have a 20% chance (30% for Mages, Priests and Warlocks) to deal Shadow damage equal to 5% of your maximum health and heal you for it. At most once every 15s, and it cannot crit.
short: 20% chance a hit (30% for Mages, Priests and Warlocks) to deal Shadow damage equal to 5% of max health. At most once every 15s.

title: Endurance
text: Health increased by 5%.
short: Health increased by 5%.

title: Berserking
text: Attack and casting speed increased by 10% for 15s, 3 min cooldown.
short: Attack and casting speed increased by 10% for 15s, 3 min cooldown.

title: Wind Blessed
text: Spellcasting, melee and ranged haste increased by 2%.
short: Spellcasting, melee and ranged haste increased by 2%.

short: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

short: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

short: Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%.

title: Chastise
text: Dwarf Priests: an instant Holy hit on a Humanoid, 2 min cooldown.
short: Dwarf Priests: an instant Holy hit on a Humanoid, 2 min cooldown.

short: Night Elf Priests: Arcane damage over 6s, 30s cooldown.

short: Undead Priests: trade health for mana over 15s, 10 min cooldown.

short: The race's own stats, with no racials.

title: Target type

short: Racials, talents and spells that work only on this creature type.

title: Warrior
text: Orc is best on Fury and Fury 2H. Undead is best on Arms. The best Alliance race on Fury is Human, 0.7% behind. Orc Blood Fury is the biggest racial on Fury, +17.6 DPS (1.8%). Against Beasts, Troll leads Fury (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 0.3% ahead of Dwarf. Against Elementals, High Order and Windshaper lead Fury (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 4.1% ahead of Orc.

title: Rogue
text: Undead is best on every Rogue preset. Gnome is next, 0.4% behind on Combat Daggers. Undead Touch of the Grave is the biggest racial on Combat Daggers, +16.7 DPS (2.2%). Against Beasts, Troll leads Combat Daggers (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 0.2% ahead of Dwarf. Against Elementals, High Order and Windshaper lead Combat Daggers (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 3.8% ahead of Undead.

title: Hunter
text: Orc is best on Beast Mastery, Marksmanship and Survival. Night Elf is best on Lone Wolf. Orc Command is the biggest racial on Beast Mastery, +15.9 DPS (1.4%). Against Beasts, Troll leads Beast Mastery (+3.6% vs the generic boss), 0.2% ahead of Dwarf. Against Elementals, High Order and Windshaper lead Beast Mastery (+3.6% vs the generic boss), 2.1% ahead of Orc.

title: Paladin
text: Undead is best on every Paladin preset. Human is next, 0.7% behind on Ret sub-Holy. Undead Touch of the Grave is the biggest racial on Ret sub-Holy, +14.4 DPS (1.5%). Against Beasts, Dwarf leads Ret sub-Holy (+4.8% vs the generic boss), 3.5% ahead of Undead.

title: Shaman
text: Orc is best on Enhancement, Enh Imp GW, Enh Water Shield and Enh Mana Tide. Windshaper is best on Elemental and Elemental Mana Tide. The best Alliance race on Enhancement is Dwarf, 0.7% behind. Orc Blood Fury is the biggest racial on Enhancement, +11.2 DPS (1.3%). Against Beasts, Dwarf leads Enhancement (+5.0% vs the generic boss), level with Troll. Against Elementals, Windshaper leads Enhancement (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 4.6% ahead of Orc.

title: Druid
text: Night Elf is best on Feral and Balance. High Order is best on Balance Wrath. The best Horde race on Feral is Windshaper, 1.5% behind. Night Elf Shadowmeld is the biggest racial on Feral, +13.4 DPS (1.6%). Against Elementals, High Order and Windshaper lead Feral (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 3.3% ahead of Night Elf.

title: Mage
text: Gnome is best on Fire, Frostfire and Arcane. High Order is best on Frost. The best Horde race on Fire is Undead, 0.3% behind. Undead Touch of the Grave is the biggest racial on Fire, +11.8 DPS (1.1%). High Order Wind Blessed costs 9.8 DPS on Frostfire. Against Beasts, Troll leads Fire (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 3.6% ahead of Gnome. Against Elementals, High Order leads Fire (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 3.8% ahead of Gnome.

title: Warlock
text: Orc is best on Demonology, Affliction and Destruction. Undead is best on Destruction Fire. Undead Touch of the Grave is the biggest racial on Demonology, +12.0 DPS (1.1%). Against Beasts, Troll leads Demonology (+4.6% vs the generic boss), 3.6% ahead of Orc.

title: Priest
text: Undead is best on every Priest preset. Troll is next, 0.3% behind on Shadow. The best Alliance race on Shadow is Human, 0.4% behind. Undead Touch of the Grave is the biggest racial on Shadow, +11.7 DPS (1.2%). Against Beasts, Troll leads Shadow (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 0.4% ahead of Dwarf.
